scope_note: Source/release certification is not corpus certification. Concrete audio remains subject to acquisition checksums, per-asset rights where applicable, semantic mapping, technical probing, grouping, deduplication, split audit and frozen-manifest certification.

profile_semantics.release_safe: Only sources with an ALLOW source-level decision may enter a release-safe frozen corpus. Per-asset policy still applies.
profile_semantics.research_extended: Sources allowed for controlled research/benchmark use subject to their license obligations and asset-level policy.
profile_semantics.field_holdout: Field-only evidence; cannot close while required authorization/hardware gates remain open.

sonyc-ust-v2.license_conclusion: Dataset-wide CC-BY-4.0 per official Zenodo record.
conditions: Preserve attribution and source release identity.
Use source-provided split/context metadata and ECHO grouping rules.
Publisher metadata/checksum snapshot is pinned and verified by the dataset-source certification workflow; full real-media bundle checksum verification is still required during EXEC-DATA-001.

fsd50k-1.0.license_conclusion: Mixed per-clip Creative Commons licenses plus dataset-level CC-BY. Official record explicitly distinguishes per-clip rights and asks commercial users to contact the authors.
conditions: No release-safe freeze until the intended-use review explicitly resolves the dataset-level commercial-use note.
Per-asset license metadata is mandatory; CC-BY-NC and Sampling+ assets cannot silently enter release-safe lineage.
Shatter is broader than ECHO GLASS_SHATTER and requires manual semantic review.
Publisher metadata/doc/ground-truth checksum snapshot is pinned and verified; full real-media bundle checksum verification remains part of EXEC-DATA-001.

singapura-v1.0a.license_conclusion: CC-BY-SA-4.0 per official Zenodo record; release-safe model/distribution use requires explicit ShareAlike/intended-use review.
conditions: Do not convert generic screeching or friction-brake labels into TIRE_SQUEAL positives.
Publisher metadata/labels/readme checksum snapshot is pinned and verified; full real-media bundle checksum verification remains part of EXEC-DATA-001.

esc50.license_conclusion: Full ESC-50 is CC-BY-NC; ESC-10 subset is CC-BY. Current ECHO adapter treats the full ESC-50 source as research-only unless a separately pinned/permitted subset is defined.
conditions: Pin an exact repository commit/archive and hash before empirical corpus certification.
Preserve source-file/take grouping and official folds.

urbansound8k-1.0.license_conclusion: CC-BY-NC-3.0; research-only in ECHO default policy.
conditions: Manual/authorized acquisition must record the archive SHA-256.
Preserve official folds and fsID/occurrence grouping.

audioset-ontology.license_conclusion: Ontology/annotation evidence is separate from the rights of underlying third-party media.
conditions: No automatic raw-media ingestion into a certified ECHO corpus.
May be used for ontology/pretraining provenance and coverage research only.

echo-field-v1.license_conclusion: Permission-specific; no capture or corpus admission before authorization/privacy/retention gates close.
conditions: Close EXT-CAMERA-001 and field authorization gates.
Keep initial field data untouched as holdout.
